activity_summary: After the afternoon you were out of the Two Gentlemen, and you did not name the part. Garnish said nothing was bought and that the K was unchanged. The Rose had a Wise Man. You did not go. Kemp kept the morning's terms. You still had no figure for his lines. Burbage had left the love speech at the stable wall.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named no part, kept the column numberless, and stayed.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Closed the afternoon and left the speech at the stable wall.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Reported the K unchanged and the Rose's bill.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Held the morning's courtesy and noted that Sam had taken no farthings.

facets.activity: Came out of the Two Gentlemen

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The K is as I left it.
